cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a craftsman's workshop of her world — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a Korean jjimjilbang hall with heated floors and sleeping mats — dries her hair with a towel; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a club powder room with a lit mirror and neon on the tiles — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; a forest path in her world — standing; a candlelit gala dinner hall — holds a cup in both hands; a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — sitting on the ground; a terrace on a castle wall overlooking the valley — standing with one foot up on a step; her living room with a deep sofa — stitches into a small embroidery hoop with fabric in it; a small repair kiosk with a cluttered workbench — holds a smartphone up at arm's length to take a selfie; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — standing
